header: São Paulo · viagens a Miami a cada 60 dias
hub_subtitle: De “eu nem tento falar” a se virar sozinha em Miami — imigração, restaurante, lojas e compras, sem sufoco e sem depender de ninguém

lesson.menu_desc: On the plane to Miami: your name, your country, your seat -- verb to be (I am, you are, it is)
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 1 -- Hello, Miami!
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Eliane Zippo Guerreiro | Lesson 1 -- Hello, Miami!
lesson.grammar_point: verb to be (affirmative: I am, you are, it is)
lesson.pre_a1_modelo: I am Eliane. I am from Brazil.

listenings.text: Good evening. I am the captain. Welcome to flight eight one six to Miami. The flight is eight hours. It is cold in São Paulo tonight, and it is hot in Miami. Please put your bag under your seat. Thank you, and have a good flight.
Hello, everyone. I am Linda, and I am your flight attendant tonight. Dinner is at nine. It is chicken or pasta. Water is free. The bathroom is at the back of the plane. I am here for you. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: Eliane is on the plane to Miami. Mark says: Good evening. Eliane says: I am Eliane. Mark says: You are in seat 14A. Eliane says: Thank you very much.
